query:
UPDATE member SET display_name = $2, role = $3, avatar = $4, color = $5, birthdate = $6,
                    grade = $7, interests = $8, hobbies = $9, responsibilities = $10,
                    aliases = $11, gender = $12, relevance_tags = $13,
                    version = version + 1
             WHERE id = $1 AND version = $14
             RETURNING version
